name: Quartic Polynomial Disguise
description: Replaces the lookup table and degree-based system risk with a single quartic polynomial $L(u,v) = (f_u - f_v)^4 - 5(f_u - f_v)^2 + 10$ evaluated over the domain $\{1, 2, 3\}$. The polynomial evaluates to 10 for equal agencies and 6 for unequal ones. The global constraint $\le 6m$ forces all edges to evaluate to 6, which requires proper 3-coloring. This defeats models that rely on recognizing the specific cancellation of the original risk equation and lookup table, forcing them to analytically deduce the minimum of the polynomial to discover the coloring constraint.
